report_discrepancies.note: Governmental Total expenditures printed 2,446,376; Total column lines add to 2,446,370 because Culture and recreation reads 173,111 in the Total column while the Park Fund column (the only fund with that line) shows 173,117.

Statement of Net Position Total column prints net investment in capital assets 8,009,233; governmental 5,934,353 + business-type 2,074,870 = 8,009,223. Equity lines therefore add to 14,901,304 vs printed total 14,901,294 (print error in the report).

notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (pp4-5). 'City taxes and fees' 678,079 split: Sales Tax Fund column 530,129 = sales tax (fund name); General 7,466 + Street 140,484 = 147,950 stay taxes (unlabeled). Debt Service Fund column is empty (moved to other funds by change in presentation, net 0 in total). Business-type from Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position (p7) Total column; receipts/disbursements totals = operating + nonoperating interest (no single printed total). ending_cash = unrestricted cash + county treasurer from the governmental funds balance sheet (restricted cash 1,702,632 excluded). Detail: the budgetary comparison schedule (p9) is a combined all-funds schedule, so it is replaced by per-fund columns of the governmental funds statement (General, Street, Sales Tax, Park), the combining schedule of other governmental funds (p10: Law Enforcement, Keno, Reading Center; Debt Services column empty), and per-fund proprietary columns (p7).
